d:
I traveled to Luxembourg to take on the Internationale Marche de Diekirch, one of Europe's most famous military marching events. Over two days, I rucked 80 kilometers (50 miles), earned an official military medal, and experienced one of the most unique endurance events I've ever participated in.
Was it worth it? Watch and find out.
In this video you'll see:
Registration and check-in process
The route and scenery through Luxembourg
What it's like to ruck 40km each day
Gear I used
Challenges, lessons learned, and mistakes
